message.mcmti.doubao.unavailable: Doubao recognizer is not configured — set the API key in the mcmti-doubao config
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.title: Doubao Plugin Config
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.apiKey.toolt: Speech API key from the Volcengine console (sent as X-Api-Key). Leave empty to disable this recognizer.
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.model.toolti: Model name, currently only bigmodel is supported
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.language.too: auto, or a code such as zh-CN / en-US / ja-JP / yue-CN (short forms like zh/en are accepted)
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.enableItn.to: Convert spoken numbers/dates into regular written form ("nineteen seventy" → "1970")
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.enablePunc.t: Add commas, periods and other punctuation to the transcript
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.enableDdc.to: Remove filler words and repetitions for a smoother transcript
mcmti_doubao.midnightconfig.requestTimeo: Total wall-clock budget for one recognition request
